notes:
Company background:
- Large regional healthcare network operating in 5 EU countries with consolidated EHR back-end. Sensitive PHI scope; strong regulatory posture (GDPR + country-level healthcare regs).
- Evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for inference workloads (clinical summarization + patient Q&A + triage assistance).
Security review status / ask list:
- Must demonstrate EU-only data residency for production tenant. Primary requirement: all inference request payloads, KV cache, and logs must remain in EU regions (IE, DE).
- UK payor/legal unit requires separate tenancy/isolated logs (cannot share with EU tenant).
- Canada ops team has a subsidiary — future expansion request: Canadian tenant (Montreal) with same controls — flagged as separate project phase.
- APAC (Singapore) considered for 2027 expansion; not in immediate scope.
- Audit logging: Full request/response metadata plus token usage metrics required. Logs must be forwardable to customer Splunk/ELK (pull or push) and have immutable retention policies.
- KMS integration: BYOK required. Customer to provide HSM-backed keys (Azure Key Vault or AWS CloudHSM). Needs proof of ability to bind keys to data-at-rest and KV cache encryption. FIPS-140-2 compliance flagged by security.
- SSO: SAML + SCIM provisioning mandated for console access. Role-based access and break-glass process documentation requested.
- Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink; strict egress restrictions; IP allowlist for management plane.
- Data handling: No backup or snapshot replication outside selected EU regions. Model weights OK to be pulled from Redwood catalog if they never contain customer data; customer prefers model variants hosted in-region.
Timeline & recent activity:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE + SE) — high-level requirements captured.
- 2026-02-04: Security review kickoff; exchanged security questionnaire (drive link).
- 2026-02-18: Technical deep-dive (Fireflies ff_20260218_8932). SE demo of VPC architecture and KMS options.
- 2026-02-25: POC spec drafted — small-scale PoC for summarization on anonymized records in EU tenant; duration 4 weeks.
- 2026-03-02: Internal procurement asked for SOW with explicit data residency & audit SLAs.
POC & technical notes:
- PoC scoped to Ireland region (eu-west-1) with planned Germany fallback (eu-central-1) for read-through model fallbacks.
- SE notes: will use prefix caching; must ensure KV cache stored on encrypted EBS volumes inside EU tenant; keys managed by customer KMS.
- Require an integration test for HSM operations (encrypt/decrypt) before production sign-off. Redwood to provide test harness and key-wrapping instructions.
Customer quotes / color:
- CTO (Dr. Lena Novak): "No PHI may leave the EU jurisdiction in any minute-to-minute operational flow. We need guarantees, telemetry, and verifiable keys."
- Head of Security: wants an auditable trail and a regulation-compliant retention plan; asked about timeline to SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence.
Next steps (short):
- Redwood to produce EU-only SOW draft including tenant topology, log forwarding options, and KMS binding steps (due 2026-03-12).
- Schedule BYOK/HSM validation session with infra team (target 2026-03-18).
- Legal to review proposed EULA adjustments for residency constraints (customer procurement lead assigned).

- Customer IT insists on verifying HSM key import/usage flow (timeline TBD).
- Need clarity on model update cadence and whether new weights will be pulled into EU-only tenant automatically or require approval.
